metadata.summary: The Narayana Sukta praises the cosmic Narayana, the all-pervading Sri Maha Vishnu, as the supreme reality. It comes from the Krishna Yajurveda, in the Taittiriya Aranyaka 10.13 and the Mahanarayana Upanishad.
metadata.usage: Chanted in the worship of Vishnu and in Vedic ritual.

chunks.translation: Om, we meditate on the thousand-headed Deity, whose eyes look upon the entire universe, the fountainhead of universal auspiciousness.
The entire universe is Lord Narayana, the imperishable divine Lord, the Supreme Abode.
Transcending the entire cosmos, eternal, all-pervading Narayana, Hari who removes all sorrow.
This entire universe is indeed the Purusha; upon that Supreme Reality all existence lives and breathes.
The Sovereign of the universe, the Ruler of the soul, the Eternal, the Auspicious, the Infallible.
Narayana, the supreme Object of knowledge, the innermost Soul of the cosmos, the ultimate Refuge.
Narayana is the supreme transcendent Light; Narayana is the supreme innermost Self.
Narayana is the supreme Brahman; Narayana is the supreme ultimate Reality.
Narayana is the highest object of contemplation; Narayana Himself is the transcendent meditation.
Whatever exists in this boundless universe that is seen or heard,
Within and without, pervading everything entirely, Narayana abides.
Resembling an inverted lotus bud is the sacred spiritual heart within the chest.
A span below the throat and above the navel, this center of consciousness shines.
In the center of that slender flame of consciousness, the Supreme Paramatman is enthroned.

chunks.sanskrit: स ब्र॒ह्मा स शि॒वः स हरिः॒ सेन्द्रः॒ सोऽक्ष॑रः पर॒मः स्व॒राट् ॥ ७ ॥
chunks.translation: He is Brahma, He is Shiva, He is Hari, He is Indra, He is the Imperishable Supreme Self-Luminous Lord.

chunks.sanskrit: ऋ॒तꣳ स॒त्यं प॑रं ब्र॒ह्म॒ पु॒रुषं॑ कृष्ण॒पिङ्ग॑लम् ।
chunks.translation: The Cosmic Order, the Absolute Truth, the Supreme Brahman, the Being adorned in dark blue and golden radiance.
Whose energy is transcendent, the all-seeing Lord of universal forms — salutations unto Thee!

chunks.sanskrit: ॐ ना॒रा॒य॒णाय॑ वि॒द्महे॑ वासुदे॒वाय॑ धीमहि । तन्नो॑ विष्णुः प्रचो॒दया᳚त् ॥
chunks.translation: We meditate upon Narayana; we contemplate Lord Vasudeva. May Lord Vishnu awaken and guide our intellect.
